card.name: Phone and fax numbers in addresses
card.fires_on: Commas and final digits right after a phone number, where a fax number or other contact detail comes next. Also commas in lists of contact items like address, phone number, fax number.

modes.description: A comma inside a list of contact details such as address, phone and fax.
